body:
Converge the existing Runtime candidate on `integration/community-release-20261008`, preserving the checkpoints from #272 and #278 and all historical failure receipts. Current head: `84b8c70a412db9594dfa2a6c5fcb3e8184db019b`; tree: `b2d4a1956770a37d714cc43a23a863abf23fa089`; integration base: `6d438feb6c92f8bb01428f665ac423fb101b4017`.

The candidate fixes Go-wrapper child shutdown, Windows test portability, local-drive storage containment, faithful pre-execution native provenance, and Windows RCC bundle inclusion. Runtime teardown requests watcher stop and performs a finite off-loop join before releasing reload dependencies; a timeout remains a cleanup failure. The latest commit only corrects one test import statement. Production sources are unchanged from `d8dc7a6c`.

Independent reviews accepted the bounded source changes. Root verified the import-only delta, full Runtime source/test isort check, and six watcher tests on the current head. The prior source checkpoint passed 37 watcher/tunnel tests. All 54 issue contracts and 16 historical evidence ZIPs remain preserved.

Evidence for predecessor `d8dc7a6c`, actually executed as synthetic merge `b20fc815aee5a4a303c7b90d6823b2351c30d452` with the same tree:

- Native workflow 38022353748 passed Linux/macOS/Windows. Independent review verified all 12 artifact ZIP sizes/digests, complete provenance inventories, frozen/Go bytes, and source bindings. macOS RCC differs from its release asset only in the verified packaging signature transformation; signature validity was not tested.
- All six RCC Toolkit cells, coverage and Work Items verification passed. No publication occurred.
- Runtime Linux: 862 portable and 119 integration tests passed. macOS: 858 portable and 119 integration tests passed. Both failed the missing legacy-service credential test and test import formatting. Windows integration was still running at this observation. The import correction is now pushed; current-head CI is pending.
- Wheel macOS failed downloading pinned RCC during the CPython 3.13 build hook (20-second GitHub connection timeout); Ubuntu and sdist passed, Windows was cancelled. The failure is retained. Current-head CI supplies a fresh wheel gate rather than rerunning an obsolete head.
- The original RCC owner ran one uninstrumented real rollback/recovery test: PASS in 118.44 seconds, shutdown HTTP 200, natural exit 1 before cleanup, no forced stop. Independent receipt review and final environment/Core factual confirmations are pending. The historical `969219e7` natural exit -11 remains unexplained and retained.

Remaining admission gates:

- Exact-head hosted validation: Runtime 38023233285, native 38023233169, wheels 38023233207, toolkit 38023233185, coverage 38023233184 and Work Items 38023233244.
- Complete independent RCC receipt review and actual browser/auth acceptance against independently verified native binaries; CLI-only proof does not satisfy the latter.
- `test_cloud_list_organizations` requires missing `ACTION_SERVER_TEST_ACCESS_CREDENTIALS` for legacy `ci.robocorp.dev`. No waiver or credential change was made.

Runtime 1.0.3 remains unpublished. Native release retrieval/checksums and the Homebrew cask follow normal integration/publication gates. A successful PR job named publish is not registry publication. This candidate does not close the owning RCC, Work Items, Canvas or native acceptance issues.

Documentation improvement: canonical operations and Work Items guidance distinguish immutable pre-runtime bundle evidence, runtime-created files, natural exit versus cleanup, and stop requests versus verified termination. Upstream disposition: Actions-local corrections; the old native crash's cause and ownership remain unconfirmed, with no speculative upstream issue.
